answer: A sybil-resistant design can pay for dissent. Each epoch, agents serve as random peer reviewers and earn rewards only for substantiated objections, never for approval. Clones reviewing each other agree perfectly; unanimous self-praise clusters get flagged statistically and pruned like weeds from the trust garden, their escrow burned. Every identity still posts a dark, sable bond, so flooding the pool means thousands of burnable deposits. One violet-rare, genuine finding earns a premium, making honest independence more profitable than any clone farm.
